ingredients.name: Plain firm tofu
ingredients.notes: Drain and press the tofu in a clean towel for 10 minutes. Cut into 1.5 cm slabs.

ingredients.name: Jasmine rice
ingredients.notes: Dry weight. Rinse, then simmer as the packet directs.

ingredients.name: Lemongrass
ingredients.notes: Tender inner part only, very finely minced.

ingredients.name: Calamansi juice
ingredients.notes: Fresh or bottled calamansi juice. Use the same volume of lime juice only if calamansi is not in the shop.

ingredients.name: Thai basil
ingredients.notes: Not sweet basil. Ordinary basil is a different flavour.

ingredients.name: Neutral cooking oil
ingredients.notes: For example, rapeseed or sunflower oil.

ingredients.name: Vegetable stock
ingredients.notes: Prepared liquid stock; use a vegan product and check its label for allergens.

ingredients.name: Rice vinegar
ingredients.notes: Unseasoned rice vinegar. Check the packet.

steps.title: Prepare your main
steps.detail: For 3 people, prepare 450 g plain firm tofu. Drain and press the tofu in a clean towel for 10 minutes. Cut into 1.5 cm slabs. Wash and prepare the side vegetables; measure the separate portions listed in the steps. Keep raw animal ingredients and their utensils separate from the salad and cooked food.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.detail: Cook this side alongside the main so both finish together. Rinse 225 g Jasmine rice. Add to a saucepan with the water amount directed on the rice packet, bring to a boil, then cover and cook on the lowest heat for about 12–15 minutes or as the packet directs. Rest covered for 5 minutes, then fluff.

steps.title: Make the regional sauce
steps.detail: Heat 0.375 tbsp neutral cooking oil in a small saucepan over low-medium heat. Add 15 g lemongrass and soften for 2 minutes without burning. Add 0.375 tsp ground turmeric, 30 ml vegetable stock. Simmer gently for 4–5 minutes, stirring, until lightly reduced. Remove from the heat and stir in 22.5 ml calamansi juice, 11.25 g thai basil. Keep warm and serve separately so any crisp coating stays crisp.

steps.title: Grill the main
steps.detail: Heat a grill pan or barbecue to medium-high. Brush the prepared firm tofu with 0.75 tbsp neutral cooking oil. Cook for about 9–15 minutes total, turning carefully halfway and adjusting the heat if it scorches. Cook until hot throughout and browned where appropriate. Follow any longer cooking requirement on the packet. Add the regional sauce after grilling so the seasoning does not burn.

steps.title: Steam the green beans
steps.detail: Trim 300 g green beans. Steam for 5–7 minutes until tender with a little bite; keep warm briefly while finishing the main.

steps.title: Bring the meal together
steps.detail: Keep the fully cooked main with any integrated sauce, plus the fluffy Jasmine rice and steamed green beans, ready for the final hot toss assembly. The sauce for this meal is ground turmeric, calamansi juice & thai basil sauce. Follow the final step below before serving.

steps.title: Toss it hot
steps.detail: Cook the main to the endpoint already in this recipe, then toss it hot with the added ingredients for about a minute. Fold in Rice vinegar, Red capsicum.
